title.purpose: Panel and section headers. The largest type in the app; there is no display tier.

body.purpose: Transcript prose and panel copy, held to a reading measure.

label.purpose: Metadata, timestamps, counts, chip text. 11px is the floor.

value.purpose: Monospace. Anything the harness emitted: ids, paths, event types, token counts.

shadows.name: composer
shadows.purpose: The resting composer — the only lifted surface in the app.

shadows.name: composer-focus
shadows.purpose: The focused composer. There is no third shadow; depth is otherwise tonal.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Disclosure chevrons and hover colour. Nothing that competes with streaming text; prefers-reduced-motion is honoured.

breakpoints.name: inspector-inline
breakpoints.purpose: Above this the inspector is an inline column; below it becomes a drawer. Derived from the chat column needing ~560px, not from a device.

breakpoints.name: history-inline
breakpoints.purpose: Above this the thread rail is an inline column; below it becomes a drawer.

breakpoints.name: harness-nav
breakpoints.purpose: Above this /harness is nav-rail + panel; below it the index is the list and a destination is a page with a back control.

layoutTokens.name: --header-height
layoutTokens.purpose: Shared by the header and the toast layer's offset. They previously agreed by coincidence, and did not.

layoutTokens.name: --z-toast
layoutTokens.purpose: One step above every portalled primitive at z-50, so a toast reporting on a sheet is readable over it.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid near-black control for the one affordance a header is for.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.21 0.006 285.885); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 0.875rem/1.25rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.21 0.006 285.885) 90%, transparent); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The default for header and row affordances. A toolbar of filled buttons is chrome competing with content.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823); height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 0.875rem/1.25rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background .15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.967 0.001 286.375); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.6 0.015 286.067); }

components.name: Panel Header
components.description: The repeated unit of the app: icon, title, and one at-a-glance value. The value is load-bearing — it is what makes opening the panel unnecessary most of the time.
components.html: Approvals1 waiting
components.css: .ds-panel-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32); font: 600 0.875rem/1.25rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823); } .ds-icon { color: oklch(0.53 0.016 285.938); flex: none; } .ds-title { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-meta { flex: none; font: 500 0.75rem/1rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: oklch(0.473 0.137 46.201); background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.473 0.137 46.201) 15%, transparent); border-radius: 10px; padding: 2px 6px; }

components.name: State Row
components.description: A status is never colour alone: every dot carries adjacent text.
components.html: 1 call is waiting on you across the harness
components.css: .ds-state { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.25rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: oklch(0.473 0.137 46.201); } .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.473 0.137 46.201); flex: none; }

narrative.overview: A window onto a running process that happens to accept messages, not a chat app that happens to log tool calls. Read daily by one operator who ran the harness themselves, so density and learned affordances are permitted and a tidier abstraction in front of what the harness reported is not. The register is instrumented, calm, exact.
keyCharacteristics: A neutral zinc field where colour means run state and nothing else.
Rules and tonal steps for separation; cards reserved for things that stop a run.
One header grammar — icon, title, one at-a-glance value — repeated at every scale.
Monospace for anything the harness emitted; proportional for anything we wrote.
Tonal depth by default. One surface floats by design, and it is the composer.

rules.name: The State-Only Rule
rules.body: Outside the four-hue run ramp, the destructive action colour and the recording indicator, the interface is neutral. There is no brand accent, and adding one is a regression.

rules.name: The Two-Client Rule
rules.body: The ramp is authored as oklch() in apps/chat-ui/src/index.css and frozen as sRGB hex in packages/design/src/tokens.ts for clients that cannot parse oklch. check-state-palette fails when they disagree. The stylesheet is authored; the hex is derived.

rules.name: The Attention-Blocked Rule
rules.body: blocked (amber) means a person is being asked to act. failed (red) means something already went wrong and nobody is being asked.

rules.name: The Provenance Rule
rules.body: Monospace marks what the harness said; proportional marks what we said.

rules.name: The 11px Floor
rules.body: Text below 11px is a smell requiring justification, not a density tool.

rules.name: The One Lifted Surface Rule
rules.body: The composer is the only element that floats by design and the only one with shadow tokens of its own. The vendored shadcn primitives still carry their default shadows; that is incumbent truth, not a pattern to copy.

rules.name: The Nesting Rule
rules.body: A pane takes whichever tonal level its container does not: bg-code-surface on the page, bg-background inside a card. Flat colours, never alphas.

rules.name: The Shrink-Floor Rule
rules.body: Anything below a scrolling region carries flexShrink: 0, or a long transcript eats the composer's rows.

dos: Do spend colour on run state and nothing else.
Do give every panel header one at-a-glance value.
Do set monospace for anything the harness emitted and proportional for anything we wrote.
Do separate with a rule or a tonal step before reaching for a card.
Do carry flexShrink: 0 on anything below a scrolling region.
Do measure contrast in each theme in its natural state, never by toggling .dark at runtime.
Do state the resting case; a signal that appears only in trouble teaches the operator not to look at it.
donts: Don't add a brand accent colour. There isn't one, and the absence is the system.
Don't stack rounded-xl bordered cards down a panel.
Don't put an icon on every row. Icons mark kinds, not rows.
Don't introduce a new shadow token; elsewhere reach for a tonal step or a rule.
Don't encode a status in colour alone, and don't use amber and red interchangeably.
Don't edit the frozen hex in packages/design to resolve a palette mismatch.
Don't drop below 11px to gain density.
Don't add motion that competes with streaming text.
